name: Honduras

flag.description: Three equal horizontal bands of turquoise blue, white and turquoise blue, with five turquoise five-pointed stars arranged in an X pattern in the centre.
flag.symbolism: The blue bands represent the Pacific Ocean and the Caribbean Sea and white the land and peace between them; the five stars stand for the five nations of the former Federal Republic of Central America and the hope of reunion.

hook: Honduras: plain blue-white-blue with five stars in an X like the five on a dice, and no coat of arms, unlike El Salvador and Nicaragua.
trivia: In 2022 Honduras officially set its flag's blue to a turquoise shade, replacing the darker navy blue that had come into use.
The Maya city of Copán in western Honduras is a UNESCO World Heritage Site famous for its carved stelae.
